eligibility: Apply frozen inventory plus n>=2 finite rows and nonzero target variance independently to every train and held subset before normalization, fitting, and assimilation; reuse only training-half normalization on held rows.
goal: honest all-label macro one-shared-q CCC >= 0.95 for unseen-entry NMR evidence assimilation
hypothesis: The target-unread physically qualified K32 supports provide useful coordinate-conditioned response diversity beyond their exact nested K8 subset under one shared observer and independent entry-wide q, chi, and reference states.
loss: Atom-balanced normalized SmoothL1 observer fitting and normalized MSE assimilation with fixed physical/q/reference priors; no CCC or concordance surrogate is optimized.
matched_controls: Exact nested K8 under the same observer, K32 no-coordinate, K32 uniform-q, and anchor-only each optimize an independent fresh allowed state.
physicality: Emit every optimized K32 state from its exact hash-bound PDB and require finite coordinates, <=1.0 Angstrom displacement, and >=0.5 Angstrom all-distinct-atom distance.
source_crossfit: Within A and B independently, deterministically split whole sequence clusters into two balanced halves, train on one and score the other, then reverse.
source_gate: K32-minus-nested-K8 and K32-minus-no-coordinate all-label macro Atom_ID CCC must each exceed 0.0005 in source A, source B, and combined OOF, which must define every frozen eligible Atom_ID. Family CCC is diagnostic only.
